name: Smoked Salmon Soba Noodle Bowl with Cucumber, Edamame & Avocado

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince or grate the ginger. Transfer to a small bowl.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, oil, and honey to the bowl and whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
1 ½ tsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pot is boiling, add the noodles and edamame; cook according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water. Return to the pot and toss with 3 tbsp of the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
510 g soba (buckwheat) noodles
2 ¼ cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, thinly slice cucumbers into match-like sticks.
Halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide noodles and edamame between bowls and top with smoked salmon, cucumbers, and avocado. Drizzle with remaining dressing and enjoy!
